summary: Close the pipeline this id names: its ticket is given up if it still waits; a load under way is given up; every model comes off, and only once every process of it has gone does the card go back. The answer waits for that, and is the pipeline closed, saying why. A generation still running on a model that comes off fails. Work still queued afterwards opens the queue's own pipeline and asks for the card again, behind whoever is in line. Refused `not_open` when the id names no open pipeline here, and `unload_failed` when a model would not come off: the pipeline stays open and holds the card, since what would not stop may still be on it.
